title: Copperplate Engraving — An Idea becomes a connected System

scenes.title: Laying the bands
scenes.purpose: Show the burin building tone purely from line density on a warm paper plate set on a dark mat.
visuals: Plate copy lettered into the left margin with a left-to-right burin wipe
Horizontal ground band, then a 45° band, then -40° and 80° cross bands that darken toward the core
Concentric tapered contour arcs ring the halo

beats.development: Parallel horizontal and diagonal hatch bands are incised line by line across the disc while the title copy is lettered in the margin.
Cross bands are laid only where the surface darkens toward the centre; contour arcs follow the round halo; the red rule and plate caption appear.
captions: SCULPSIT · THE LIGHT RELEASED FROM THE DARK

scenes.title: Light released
scenes.purpose: Release the light-bulb idea as bare paper out of the dense dark and connect it into a system.
visuals: Bulb-shaped paper reserve burnished outward from the core
Single-pass outline incision, glass highlight strokes and screw collar
Ink filament then red accent triangle and nodes inside the bare paper

beats.development: The bulb grows as clean paper out of the cross-hatched dark, then its outline, highlights and collar are incised.
The filament links the parts and the red connected-system triangle and nodes snap in; the bare-paper highlight is held settled.

findings: All motion completes by 2.5 s; the copy is fully lettered by 0.8 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.5–3.0 s hold on the released bare-paper bulb, as the style asks to hold the emerging highlight.

notes: Primary Motion Graphic style-160 characteristic action demonstrated; no reviewed preview recipes exist in STYLE.json.

Canvas state lives on a detached paused GSAP timeline driven by a getter/setter tween inside the registered timeline (fires on every render, including suppressed-event seeks) and by hf-seek; all marks are seeded.
